subject: mathematics
concept: Calculating the surface area of three-dimensional solids using nets
source_inspiration: adapted from Singapore CPA sequencing principles — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student unfolds a physical or virtual 3D solid into its net and identifies each face's area
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a 3D solid to its correct unfolded net
exercise.abstract: Student calculates the total surface area of a solid using its net

misconception_flags: omits a face of the solid when summing the net's areas

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
